meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 用统一接口查询40多个生物信息学数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个生物数据库间进行联合查询和ID映射
copy.tagline_en: Query 40+ bioinformatics databases with a unified interface
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple biological databases and map IDs across them

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你用 Python 查询 40 多个生物信息学数据库（如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL），进行跨数据库检索、ID 转换、序列分析和通路分析。
howto.when: 当你需要同时查询多个生物数据库，或进行跨数据库的 ID 映射、通路分析时触发。适合复杂工作流，简单单库查询建议用 gget。

say.text: 帮我查一下人类 ZAP70 蛋白的序列和 KEGG 通路。
say.note: 会调用 UniProt 和 KEGG 返回序列和通路信息。

say.text: 把 KEGG 化合物 C11222 映射到 ChEMBL ID。
say.note: 会使用 UniChem 进行跨数据库 ID 转换。

say.text: 用 BLAST 搜索这段蛋白序列的同源物。
say.note: 需要先设置 NCBI_EMAIL 环境变量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query 40+ bioinformatics databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, etc.) via Python, perform cross-database searches, ID mapping, sequence analysis, and pathway analysis.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to query multiple biological databases simultaneously or perform cross-database ID mapping and pathway analysis. Suitable for complex workflows; for simple single-database lookups, use gget.

say_en.text: Retrieve the sequence and KEGG pathways for human ZAP70 protein.
say_en.note: Calls UniProt and KEGG to return sequence and pathway info.

say_en.text: Map KEGG compound C11222 to ChEMBL ID.
say_en.note: Uses UniChem for cross-database ID conversion.

say_en.text: Run BLAST search for this protein sequence.
say_en.note: Requires NCBI_EMAIL environment variable to be set.
